diggs:SpecificationRegistry.gml:description: Canonical citations of the published standards, codes, recommendations, test methods, agency special provisions and research reports cited across DIGGS practice. A data provider cites an entry by xlink:href from a property typed diggs:SpecificationPropertyType - normally diggs:AbstractTestProcedureType/testProcedureMethod, but also diggs:AbstractSpecimenType/preparationProcedure, diggs:AbstractSamplingActivity/samplingMethod, and any other Specification-typed property - rather than retyping the standard's bibliographic detail. The href targets the diggs:Specification's gml:id, so it resolves to exactly the kind of object an instance would otherwise have carried inline; the enclosing diggs:SpecificationRegistryEntry carries the registration metadata, and its occurrences declare where the entry may legitimately be cited. One registry serves every domain of practice - see diggs:SpecificationRegistry's own schema documentation for why a per-domain split was tried and withdrawn - and each entry's domain element (coded against specificationDomain.xml) classifies which domain(s) cite it, so the registry stays browsable and filterable by practice area without being split into several files. Populated first for rigid inclusions, derived from the 'Required by (source)' column of the DIGGS rigid inclusions technical report, which populates it on all 235 essential parameters; laboratory testing, in-situ testing, sampling and construction domains are added as entries under the same registry rather than as separate documents.
diggs:SpecificationRegistry.gml:name: DIGGS Specification Registry

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national research project recommendations for rigid inclusion ground improvement. Source of the Domain 1 / Domain 2 reinforcement distinction and of the settlement efficacy definition (Eq 2.23, p. 79).
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASIRI National Project Recommendations (2012)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Recommendations for the design, construction and control of rigid inclusion ground improvements

diggs:Specification.gml:description: British code of practice covering basal reinforcement over piled embankments, including the requirement that reinforcement carry at least 15 percent of the load.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: BS 8006-1:2010+A1:2016
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Code of practice for strengthened/reinforced soils and other fills

diggs:Specification.gml:description: German recommendations for geosynthetic-reinforced earth structures. Source of the Zaeske arching model and of the Winkler subgrade reaction treatment of load transfer.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EBGEO (2011)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Recommendations for design and analysis of earth structures using geosynthetic reinforcements

diggs:Specification.gml:description: US Federal Highway Administration reference manual for ground modification. Source of the generalized parabolic and beam methods, the stress-reduction ratio and the membrane factor of Table 6-2.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: FHWA GEC-13 (FHWA-NHI-16-028)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical Engineering Circular No. 13: Ground Modification Methods Reference Manual

diggs:Specification.gml:description: European standard for geotechnical design. Source of the Design Approach safety formats and of the consequence class framework.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: Eurocode 7 - EN 1997
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Eurocode 7: Geotechnical design

diggs:Specification.gml:description: European execution standard for displacement piles, covering the installation technique families used for rigid inclusions.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN 12699:2015
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Execution of special geotechnical works - Displacement piles

diggs:Specification.gml:description: European execution standard for deep mixing, covering soil-mixed columns and soil-mixed load transfer platforms.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN 14679
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Execution of special geotechnical works - Deep mixing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French unified technical document for the design and execution of ground-bearing concrete slabs, commonly the supported structure over a rigid inclusion treated area.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: DTU 13.3
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Dallages - Conception, calcul et execution (concrete ground-bearing slabs)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: US model building code chapter governing soils and foundations, including the seismic site class framework.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: IBC 2024 Chapter 18
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: International Building Code, Chapter 18: Soils and Foundations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national application document to Eurocode 7 for shallow foundations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NF P94-261
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Justification des ouvrages geotechniques - Fondations superficielles

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national application document to Eurocode 7 for deep foundations. Governs the verification of Domain 1 inclusions as deep foundations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NF P94-262
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Justification des ouvrages geotechniques - Fondations profondes

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Dutch design guideline for piled embankments. Source of the Concentric Arches load transfer model; ranked among the more accurate methods by Han et al. (2025).
diggs:Specification.gml:name: CUR 226
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Ontwerprichtlijn paalmatrassystemen (Design guideline for piled embankments)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Static axial compressive load testing of deep foundations, applied to rigid inclusion trial and production columns.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1143
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Deep Foundations Under Static Axial Compressive Load

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Low strain impact integrity testing, the basis of the low-strain integrity verification of rigid inclusion columns. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2025 with no replacement named; a reinstatement effort (ASTM work item WK93548) is in progress. Retained and citable for the same reason ASTM D1194 is - the workbook, the industry, and instances published before and after the withdrawal all mean this standard by "PIT"/low-strain integrity testing.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D5882 (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Low Strain Impact Integrity Testing of Deep Foundations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Rapid (force pulse) load testing of deep foundations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D7383
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Axial Compressive Force Pulse (Rapid) Testing of Deep Foundations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: High-strain dynamic testing of deep foundations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4945
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for High-Strain Dynamic Testing of Deep Foundations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Static axial compressive load testing of piles by the maintained-load method, the current European counterpart to ASTM D1143 for the same test - the standard most ASIRI-governed European rigid inclusion projects cite for a static load test, superseding the withdrawn NF P94-150-1 that ASIRI (2012) itself was written against.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN ISO 22477-1
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Testing of geotechnical structures - Part 1: Testing of piles: static compression load testing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Rapid (force-pulse) axial compressive load testing of piles, the European counterpart to ASTM D7383 for the same test.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN ISO 22477-10
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Testing of geotechnical structures - Part 10: Testing of piles: rapid load testing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: High-strain dynamic load testing of piles, the European counterpart to ASTM D4945 for the base impact-testing method, and broader in scope - it also covers driving-formula, wave-equation and multi-blow dynamic testing under the same standard number.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN ISO 22477-4
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Testing of geotechnical structures - Part 4: Dynamic load testing of piles

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Tensile testing of geogrids, the source of the characteristic tensile strength used in load transfer platform reinforcement design.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D6637
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Determining Tensile Properties of Geogrids by the Single or Multi-Rib Tensile Method

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Nonrepetitive static plate load testing, used for plate bearing verification over a treated area.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1196
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Nonrepetitive Static Plate Load Tests of Soils and Flexible Pavement Components

diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1194 (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Bearing Capacity of Soil for Static Load and Spread Footings

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The German static plate load test - the third tradition alongside ASTM D1195/D1196 for the same test class, distinct in prescribing exactly two load cycles and reporting two named deformation moduli (Ev1, Ev2) whose ratio indicates degree of compaction.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: DIN 18134
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Baugrund - Untersuchung von Bodenproben - Bestimmung des Verformungsmoduls und des Verformungsmoduls durch Plattendruckversuche (Soil - Testing procedures and testing equipment - Plate load test)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: USCS soil classification. Registered as a citable governing document; the classification values themselves are controlled by the astmD2487 code list.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D2487
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Classification of Soils for Engineering Purposes (Unified Soil Classification System)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Visual-manual soil description. Registered as a citable governing document; the description values themselves are controlled by the astmD2488 code list.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D2488
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Description and Identification of Soils (Visual-Manual Procedures)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Menard pressuremeter testing, the source of the pressuremeter modulus and limit pressure used in French rigid inclusion design practice.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ISO 22476-4
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Field testing - Part 4: Menard pressuremeter test

diggs:Specification.gml:description: State agency special provision specifying permitted inclusion types and acceptance requirements.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: KDOT special provision
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Kansas Department of Transportation special provision for rigid inclusions / column-supported embankments

diggs:Specification.gml:description: State agency special provision specifying permitted inclusion types, instrumentation and acceptance requirements.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: MnDOT special provision
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Minnesota Department of Transportation special provision for rigid inclusions / column-supported embankments

diggs:Specification.gml:description: State agency special provision specifying permitted inclusion types and acceptance requirements.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: IaDOT special provision
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Iowa Department of Transportation special provision for rigid inclusions / column-supported embankments

diggs:Specification.gml:description: State agency special provision specifying permitted inclusion types and acceptance requirements.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: PennDOT special provision
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Pennsylvania Department of Transportation special provision for rigid inclusions / column-supported embankments

diggs:Specification.gml:description: US national cooperative highway research program project developing AASHTO specifications for column-supported embankments.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NCHRP 10-121
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Proposed AASHTO specifications and commentary for column-supported embankments

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Deep Foundations Institute publication on rigid inclusion practice; source of the seismic site class commentary.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: DFI - Smith et al. (2023a)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Deep Foundations Institute guidance on rigid inclusions (Smith et al., 2023a)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Companion Deep Foundations Institute publication on rigid inclusion practice.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: DFI - Smith et al. (2023b)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Deep Foundations Institute guidance on rigid inclusions (Smith et al., 2023b)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Comparative evaluation of column-supported embankment design methods; source of the accuracy ranking that places CUR 226 among the more accurate methods.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: Han et al. (2025) - FHWA-KS-25-02
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Evaluation of design methods for column-supported embankments (Han et al., 2025)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national standard for the reflection (sonic-echo) method of low-strain foundation-element integrity auscultation - the French-tradition counterpart to ASTM D5882's Pulse Echo Method, registered as its own separate standard rather than one method choice within a wider document.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NF P94-160-2
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Sols : reconnaissance et essais - Auscultation d'un element de fondation - Partie 2 : methode par reflexion

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national standard for the impedance method of low-strain foundation-element integrity auscultation - the French-tradition counterpart to ASTM D5882's Transient Response Method, registered as its own separate standard rather than one method choice within a wider document.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NF P94-160-4
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Sols : reconnaissance et essais - Auscultation d'un element de fondation - Partie 4 : methode par impedance

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Thermal integrity profiling of cast-in-place concrete deep foundation elements, relating the heat of hydration generated by curing concrete to as-built cross-section and continuity. Withdrawn 2023, reinstated 2025 as D7949-25 under a broader title ("Integrity Testing of Concrete Deep Foundations by Thermal Methods") that drops the original edition's "Thermal Integrity Profiling" branding and adds a third measurement method (embedded fiber-optic cable). No European or ISO counterpart exists - checked, not assumed; EN 1536/EN 1538 recognise the technique but do not define a competing method of their own.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D7949
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Integrity Testing of Concrete Deep Foundations by Thermal Methods

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Static lateral (transverse) load-deflection testing of deep foundation elements or groups, applicable regardless of installation method. Current, not withdrawn.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D3966/D3966M
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Deep Foundation Elements Under Static Lateral Load

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national standard for static lateral (transverse) load testing of an isolated pile - the French-tradition counterpart to ASTM D3966/D3966M. Current, not withdrawn.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NF P94-151
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Sols : reconnaissance et essais - Essai statique de pieu isole sous effort transversal

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The Standard Penetration Test. Drives a split-barrel sampler with a 63.5 kg hammer falling 760 mm and reports the blow count over the 150-450 mm interval as the N value, recovering a disturbed sample for identification at the same time; it is therefore both an in-situ test method and a sampling method. Cited by the Jazera Royal Palace substation investigation as ASTM D-1586-2011.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1586/D1586M
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Standard Penetration Test (SPT) and Split-Barrel Sampling of Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Particle-size distribution by sieving above 75 micrometres and by hydrometer sedimentation below it. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2016 with no direct one-to-one replacement; the successor methods are ASTM D6913/D6913M for sieve analysis and ASTM D7928 for sedimentation. Registered because it remains widely cited by projects in progress, including the Jazera Royal Palace substation investigation.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D422
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Particle-Size Analysis of Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The Atterberg limits. Determines liquid limit by Casagrande cup (multipoint Method A or one-point Method B), plastic limit by thread rolling, and plasticity index as their difference. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2026; a reinstatement effort (ASTM work item WK93281) is open. Registered because it is cited by projects in progress and is the basis of the plasticity input to ASTM D2487 classification. AASHTO T 89/T 90 cover the same two limits by the same methods; ISO 17892-12 and BS 1377-2 cover them plus the fall-cone (cone penetrometer) method as an alternative to the Casagrande cup for liquid limit.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4318
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Liquid Limit, Plastic Limit, and Plasticity Index of Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The modified Proctor compaction test. Establishes the relationship between water content and dry unit weight using a 4.54 kg rammer dropped 457 mm, giving maximum dry density and optimum moisture content. Method C, used at Jazera, compacts five layers of 56 blows in a 152 mm mould.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1557
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Laboratory Compaction Characteristics of Soil Using Modified Effort (56,000 ft-lbf/ft3 (2,700 kN-m/m3))

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The California Bearing Ratio of laboratory-compacted subgrade, subbase and base course materials, reported as a percentage of the load on a standard crushed-stone reference at 2.54 and 5.08 mm penetration. Normally run on specimens compacted at several efforts (10, 25 and 56 blows per layer) so CBR can be interpolated at a specified percentage of maximum dry density, and optionally soaked to record swell.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1883
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for California Bearing Ratio (CBR) of Laboratory-Compacted Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Maximum index dry density of cohesionless, free-draining soils using a vertically vibrating table. Used with ASTM D4254 to compute relative density, which the Jazera investigation specifies as the acceptance basis for granular backfill. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2025.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4253
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Maximum Index Density and Unit Weight of Soils Using a Vibratory Table

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Minimum index dry density of cohesionless, free-draining soils, and the calculation of relative density from it together with the maximum index density of ASTM D4253. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2025; a reinstatement work item (WK99698) was open at the time of registration.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4254
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Minimum Index Density and Unit Weight of Soils and Calculation of Relative Density

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Chemical and electro-chemical test methods for soil, weak rock and groundwater, covering pH, sulfate, chloride, carbonate, organic matter and electrical resistivity. Used to assess ground aggressiveness towards buried concrete and steel. The Jazera Royal Palace substation investigation cites it for pH, sulfate, chloride and magnesium determinations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: BS 1377-3
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Methods of test for soils for civil engineering purposes. Chemical and electro-chemical testing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Soil electrical resistivity by the Wenner four-electrode array: a current is driven between the outer electrodes and the potential drop measured between the inner pair, with the electrode spacing controlling the depth of investigation. Covers both in-situ measurement and measurement on samples removed from the ground in a soil box. Results support corrosion assessment and earthing design, and are commonly classified for soil corrosivity.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM G57
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Measurement of Soil Resistivity Using the Wenner Four-Electrode Method

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Practical test methods for the electrical characteristics of grounding systems, including earth resistivity measurement, power-frequency and transient ground impedance to remote earth, touch and step voltages, and grounding-system integrity. Cited alongside ASTM G57 for the four-electrode resistivity surveys in the Jazera Royal Palace substation investigation.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: IEEE Std 81
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: IEEE Guide for Measuring Earth Resistivity, Ground Impedance, and Earth Surface Potentials of a Grounding System

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Thermal conductivity of soil and rock by the transient thermal needle probe: a line heat source is energised and the rate of temperature rise is interpreted for the thermal constants of the surrounding medium. Applicable to intact and reconstituted specimens and effective both in the laboratory and in the field. Thermal resistivity is reported as its reciprocal.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D5334
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Determination of Thermal Conductivity of Soil and Rock by Thermal Needle Probe Procedure

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Thermal resistivity measurement of soils and of backfill materials used to encase buried cable systems, including concrete, engineered backfill, grout, rock and sand. Describes probe designs for both laboratory and field use and rests on the same line heat source theory as ASTM D5334. Underpins the ampacity rating of underground cable circuits.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: IEEE Std 442-2017
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: IEEE Guide for Thermal Resistivity Measurements of Soils and Backfill Materials

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The loading code of the Saudi Building Code. Chapter 11 sets the seismic design criteria and mapped ground motion values, Chapter 20 the site classification procedure and site class definitions, and Chapter 22 the seismic ground motion maps. It is the source of the Ss, S1, site class, Fa and Fv values reported for the Jazera Royal Palace substation site.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: SBC 301-CR-18
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: The Saudi Loading Code, Code Requirements

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Saudi Electricity Company material standard specification for normal-weight ready-mixed Portland cement concrete on SEC projects, covering mix design, constituent materials, quality control, delivery and testing, with strength and durability requirements keyed to exposure condition. The Jazera Royal Palace substation report tabulates its concrete requirements for very severe exposure. Bibliographic detail is taken from the citing project report and secondary sources; the controlled document was not publicly retrievable at the time of registration.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: 70-TMSS-03
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Technical Material Standard Specification - Normal weight ready-mixed Portland cement concrete

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The AASHTO soil classification system. Classifies soils into seven groups (A-1 to A-7) from laboratory particle-size distribution, liquid limit and plasticity index, and rates quality within a group by the calculated group index. Widely used for highway subgrade and subbase evaluation. Equivalent to ASTM D3282. DIGGS carries its codes in aashtoM145.xml and its group symbols in grp-aashtoM145.xml.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: AASHTO M 145
diggs:Specification.diggs:accreditingBody: American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Specification for Classification of Soils and Soil-Aggregate Mixtures for Highway Construction Purposes

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The controlling document for the USDA soil textural triangle. Defines the twelve standard textural classes from the relative proportions of sand, silt and clay in the fraction finer than 2 mm; the equilateral triangle was adopted by USDA in 1951 and has been carried in successive editions of the Manual, most recently the March 2017 edition issued by the Soil Science Division Staff. DIGGS carries its classes in usda.xml.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: USDA Soil Survey Manual (Agriculture Handbook 18)
diggs:Specification.diggs:accreditingBody: United States Department of Agriculture, Natural Resources Conservation Service
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Soil Survey Manual

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Defines the British Soil Classification System (BSCS) alongside its recommendations for the planning and execution of ground investigations. The A1:2020 amendment aligned its soil and rock description with BS EN ISO 14688 and 14689 (2018) and with BS EN ISO 17892 and the related parts of BS 1377.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: BS 5930
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Code of practice for ground investigations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Procedures for the identification and description of soil by visual and manual techniques, covering both material and mass characteristics. Part 1 of the two-part standard that carries the European soil classification system; it is used together with ISO 14688-2, and is adopted in Europe as EN ISO 14688-1. Applies to natural soils in situ, reworked soils and synthetic materials; rock is covered by ISO 14689 instead.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ISO 14688-1
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Identification and classification of soil - Part 1: Identification and description

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The classification half of the European soil classification system: having identified and described a soil under ISO 14688-1, Part 2 gives the means to group soils of similar composition and geotechnical properties from field and laboratory test results, according to their suitability for geotechnical engineering purposes. Adopted in Europe as EN ISO 14688-2.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ISO 14688-2
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Identification and classification of soil - Part 2: Principles for a classification

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The Indian Standard Soil Classification System (ISSCS). Classifies soils for general engineering purposes from grain-size distribution and plasticity, using group symbols closely related to those of the Unified Soil Classification System. Maintained by BIS technical committee CED 43 and reaffirmed in 2021.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: IS 1498
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Classification and identification of soils for general engineering purposes

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The Chinese national standard for engineering soil classification, formulated to unify soil classification and the qualitative evaluation of soil properties. Takes 5 mm as the boundary between coarse- and fine-grained material, and subdivides by organic content into inorganic soil, organic soil, peaty soil and peat. Published by China Planning Press. The issuing agency recorded here is corroborated by secondary sources only; the controlled document was not publicly retrievable at the time of registration.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: GB/T 50145-2007
diggs:Specification.diggs:accreditingBody: Ministry of Water Resources of the People's Republic of China
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard for engineering classification of soil

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The Brazilian soil classification system: a hierarchical, multicategorical and open taxonomic system covering all soils occurring in Brazil, with six categorical levels - order, suborder, great group, subgroup, family and series. The fifth revised and expanded edition was released by Embrapa in August 2018 at the 21st World Congress of Soil Science and is distributed free as an e-book (ISBN 978-85-7035-800-4); it was the first edition also issued in English.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: SiBCS (5th edition, 2018)
diggs:Specification.diggs:accreditingBody: Empresa Brasileira de Pesquisa Agropecuaria (Embrapa Solos)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Sistema Brasileiro de Classificacao de Solos

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The New Zealand guideline for field logging of soil and rock. Its stated aim is to reduce the subjective nature and variability of descriptions of materials encountered during investigation, design and construction, and it is written principally for use in the field where descriptions are recorded on logs.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NZGS Field Description of Soil and Rock (2005)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Guideline for the Field Classification and Description of Soil and Rock for Engineering Purposes

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The Japanese engineering soil classification system. Follows the general form of the Unified Soil Classification System but adds provisions for cohesive volcanic soils (symbols VL, VH1 and VH2) and terms for very high (liquid limit 70-90) and extremely high (liquid limit above 90) plasticity. Issued by the Japanese Geotechnical Society and available in English translation since the society began translating its standards in 2014.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: JGS 0051
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Method of classification of geomaterials for engineering purposes

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Technical principles for the sampling of soil, rock and groundwater for geotechnical purposes, including the sampling category (A-E) and soil sample quality class (1-5) systems that diggs:AbstractSamplingActivityType/samplingCategory and diggs:SampleType/qualityClass are bound to. Second edition (2021) adds Categories D and E for both soil and rock beyond the first edition's A-C, and moves groundwater-measurement clauses to ISO 18674-4. Registered as R16's general anchor for SamplingActivity/samplingMethod, superseding ASTM for several sample forms (thin-walled tube, ring-lined barrel) whose own ASTM standards have been withdrawn with no replacement.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ISO 22475-1
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Sampling methods and groundwater measurements - Part 1: Technical principles for the sampling of soil, rock and groundwater

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Soil exploration and sampling by auger borings - hand or power augers used to advance a hole and recover disturbed samples of the cuttings.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1452/D1452M
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Soil Exploration and Sampling by Auger Borings

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Sampling of soil using the hydraulically operated stationary-piston sampler, held stationary at the sampling depth to reduce disturbance in soft or sensitive soils.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D6519/D6519M
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Sampling of Soil Using the Hydraulically Operated Stationary Piston Sampler

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Obtaining intact (cubical and cylindrical) block samples of soil, hand-cut from an excavation or trial pit to preserve orientation and structure. Renamed from "Undisturbed Block..." in its -04 edition to "Intact Block..." in -18, matching this project's own preference for "intact" over "undisturbed" (diggs:SoilSpecimen/specimenType already documents "intact" as its first term).
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D7015/D7015M
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practices for Obtaining Intact Block (Cubical and Cylindrical) Samples of Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Guide for selecting a subsurface soil and rock sampling device appropriate to the investigation's objectives and ground conditions. Retitled in its -21 edition to explicitly cover geotechnical investigations alongside environmental ones, having previously been environmental-only.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D6169/D6169M
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Guide for Selection of Subsurface Soil and Rock Sampling Devices for Environmental and Geotechnical Investigations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Direct-push soil sampling for environmental site characterization, advancing a sampler by static or vibratory push rather than rotary or percussive drilling. Found while researching R16's withdrawal picture; not previously registered.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D6282/D6282M
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Guide for Direct Push Soil Sampling for Environmental Site Characterizations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Active (pumped) soil-gas sampling in the vadose zone for vapor intrusion evaluations - the basis of diggs:SampleType/type value soil_gas_active. Confirmed active, with a further reapproved edition (D7663-12R24) beyond the -12(2018)e1 edition checked here.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D7663
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Active Soil Gas Sampling in the Vadose Zone for Vapor Intrusion Evaluations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Thin-walled (Shelby) tube sampling of fine-grained soils - the basis of diggs:SampleType/type value thin_walled_tube. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2024 with no replacement named. Registered because ISO 22475-1 section 6.3.2 is now the only standing anchor for this sample form, and project records predating the withdrawal still cite the ASTM designation directly.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1587/D1587M (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Thin-Walled Tube Sampling of Fine-Grained Soils for Geotechnical Purposes

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Thick-wall, ring-lined, split-barrel drive sampling of soils - the basis of diggs:SampleType/type value ring_lined_barrel. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2026 with no replacement named.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D3550/D3550M (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Thick Wall, Ring-Lined, Split Barrel, Drive Sampling of Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Rock core drilling and sampling of rock for site exploration - the basis of diggs:SampleType/type value rotary_core where the recovered material is rock. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2023; a reinstatement effort (ASTM work item WK94321) is open, the same administrative-lapse pattern as ASTM D5882 (entry_astm_d5882, above) rather than deliberate obsolescence.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D2113 (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Rock Core Drilling and Sampling of Rock for Site Exploration

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Preserving and transporting soil samples between the field and the laboratory. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2023; two reinstatement efforts (ASTM work items WK90906 and WK95514) are open.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4220/D4220M (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practices for Preserving and Transporting Soil Samples

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Passive (sorbent) soil-gas sampling in the vadose zone - the basis of diggs:SampleType/type value soil_gas_passive. Withdrawn by ASTM on 2026-01-16 with no replacement named; currently no active ASTM standard covers passive soil-gas sampling technique specifically.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D7758 (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Passive Soil Gas Sampling in the Vadose Zone for Source Identification, Spatial Variability Assessment, Monitoring, and Vapor Intrusion Evaluations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Particle-size distribution of soils by sieve analysis. The direct successor to the sieve-analysis portion of ASTM D422 (withdrawn 2016) - see that entry's own description; paired with D7928 for the hydrometer/sedimentation portion D422 also used to cover. Registered because D422 names it as a successor without it being registered itself.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D6913/D6913M
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Particle-Size Distribution (Gradation) of Soils Using Sieve Analysis

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Particle-size distribution of fine-grained soils by sedimentation (hydrometer) analysis. The direct successor to the hydrometer portion of ASTM D422 (withdrawn 2016); paired with D6913/D6913M for the sieve-analysis portion. Registered for the same reason as D6913/D6913M.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D7928
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Particle-Size Distribution (Gradation) of Fine-Grained Soils Using the Sedimentation (Hydrometer) Analysis

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Classification of soils and soil-aggregate mixtures for highway construction, using the same seven-group (A-1 to A-7) system and group-index calculation as AASHTO M 145 - the two are equivalent, ASTM's and AASHTO's versions of the same classification. Registered because AASHTO M 145's own entry names it as the ASTM equivalent without it being registered itself.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D3282
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Classification of Soils and Soil-Aggregate Mixtures for Highway Construction Purposes

diggs:Specification.gml:description: European execution standard for bored piles - piles or barrettes formed in the ground by excavation. Registered because ASTM D7949's own entry cites it (alongside EN 1538) as recognising thermal integrity profiling without defining a competing method of its own; not itself a testing standard, and not a rigid inclusion technique.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN 1536:2010+A1:2015
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Execution of special geotechnical works - Bored piles

diggs:Specification.gml:description: European execution standard for diaphragm walls, used as either retaining walls or cut-off walls. Registered for the same reason as EN 1536 - named alongside it in ASTM D7949's entry; not itself a testing standard, and not a rigid inclusion technique.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN 1538:2010+A1:2015
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Execution of special geotechnical works - Diaphragm walls

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Identification, description and classification of rock for geotechnical and engineering-geology purposes - the rock counterpart to ISO 14688-1/14688-2's soil classification. The current (2017) edition unified what had previously been split out as ISO 14689-1 (2003) into a single document; there is no longer a "-1" part. Registered because both BS 5930's and ISO 14688-1's own entries name it as the rock-classification standard neither of them is.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ISO 14689
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Identification, description and classification of rock

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Determining the liquid limit of soils by the Casagrande (percussion cup) method - AASHTO's counterpart to the liquid-limit half of ASTM D4318 (withdrawn 2026). Registered as part of covering the Atterberg-limits standard landscape now that D4318 itself is withdrawn.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: AASHTO T 89
diggs:Specification.diggs:accreditingBody: American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Method of Test for Determining the Liquid Limit of Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Determining the plastic limit and plasticity index of soils - AASHTO's counterpart to the plastic-limit half of ASTM D4318 (withdrawn 2026). Paired with AASHTO T 89 for the liquid limit.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: AASHTO T 90
diggs:Specification.diggs:accreditingBody: American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Method of Test for Determining the Plastic Limit and Plasticity Index of Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Shrinkage limit and shrinkage ratio of cohesive soils by water submersion - the current, non-hazardous shrinkage-limit method. Reuses the D4943 designation of an earlier, unrelated method (shrinkage factors by the wax method, itself withdrawn 2017); the water-submersion method is a distinct successor test, not a revision of the wax-method procedure that previously held this number.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4943
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Shrinkage Factors of Cohesive Soils by the Water Submersion Method

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Shrinkage factors (shrinkage limit and shrinkage ratio) of soils by the mercury method. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2008 because of mercury's hazards; D4943's water-submersion method is the direct, non-hazardous replacement. Registered because it remains the standard historically cited by shrinkage-limit results predating 2008.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D427 (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Test Method for Shrinkage Factors of Soils by the Mercury Method

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Determination of the liquid and plastic limits of soil, covering BOTH the fall-cone (cone penetrometer) method and the Casagrande (percussion cup) method as equally valid alternatives in one standard. The international counterpart to ASTM D4318 (withdrawn 2026), and this registry's primary citable source for the fall-cone method specifically.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ISO 17892-12
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Laboratory testing of soil - Part 12: Determination of liquid and plastic limits

diggs:Specification.gml:description: British classification tests for soils: liquid limit (by cone penetrometer or by the percussion-cup method - the cone penetrometer method is the only practicable procedure for low-plasticity soils where a percussion-cup groove is hard to obtain), plastic limit and plasticity index, and linear shrinkage and shrinkage limit. Registered as the British counterpart to ASTM D4318 (withdrawn 2026) and ISO 17892-12, and as another citable source for the fall-cone (cone penetrometer) method specifically.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: BS 1377-2
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Methods of test for soils for civil engineering purposes - Part 2: Classification tests

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Minimum laboratory soil resistivity by the soil box method, measured on a soil-water slurry and progressively diluted to find the minimum value. Its principal use is to assess the corrosivity of a soil toward buried metal, and it is the laboratory counterpart to the field four-electrode (Wenner) survey of ASTM G57. Normally read together with AASHTO T 289 (pH), T 290 (water-soluble sulfate) and T 291 (water-soluble chloride) as the AASHTO soil-corrosivity series.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: AASHTO T 288
diggs:Specification.diggs:accreditingBody: American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Method of Test for Determining Minimum Laboratory Soil Resistivity

diggs:Specification.gml:description: pH of soil for corrosion testing, by pH meter on a soil-water slurry. The standard states that the principal use of the test is to supplement soil-resistivity measurement rather than to stand alone, identifying conditions under which corrosion of buried metal may be accentuated. The AASHTO counterpart to ASTM G51, and to the pH determination of BS 1377-3 Clause 12.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: AASHTO T 289
diggs:Specification.diggs:accreditingBody: American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Method of Test for Determining pH of Soil for Use in Corrosion Testing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Water-soluble sulfate ion content of soil. Reports the WATER-SOLUBLE fraction specifically, as distinct from acid-soluble sulfate or total sulfur - a distinction that matters because the three can differ by an order of magnitude on the same material and feed different ground-aggressivity classifications. The AASHTO counterpart to ASTM C1580, and to the 2:1 water extract of BS 1377-3 Clause 7.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: AASHTO T 290
diggs:Specification.diggs:accreditingBody: American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Method of Test for Determining Water-Soluble Sulfate Ion Content in Soil

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Water-soluble chloride ion content of soil; the standard defines the procedures for sampling and testing a soil for chloride ion content. Reports the WATER-SOLUBLE fraction specifically, as distinct from the acid-soluble chloride of BS 1377-3 Clause 9. Completes the AASHTO soil-corrosivity series alongside T 288 (resistivity), T 289 (pH) and T 290 (sulfate).
diggs:Specification.gml:name: AASHTO T 291
diggs:Specification.diggs:accreditingBody: American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Method of Test for Determining Water-Soluble Chloride Ion Content in Soil

diggs:Specification.gml:description: pH of soil for corrosion evaluation, by pH meter. The standard states that its principal use is to supplement soil-resistivity measurement (ASTM G57) and thereby identify conditions under which the corrosion of metals in soil may be accentuated. NOTE THE TITLE CHANGED WITH THE CURRENT EDITION: editions through G51-18 read "for Use in Corrosion Testing", while G51-23 reads "for Use in Corrosion Evaluations" - the designation is unchanged and the earlier title will be the one cited by older reports. The ASTM counterpart to AASHTO T 289.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM G51
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Measuring pH of Soil for Use in Corrosion Evaluations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Water-soluble sulfate in soil, developed to determine whether a soil could react adversely with hydraulic cement concrete. Covers water-soluble sulfate concentrations between 0.02 % and 3.33 % sulfate by mass, and determines sulfur only in the sulfate form - not total sulfur and not sulfide. Reports the WATER-SOLUBLE fraction specifically; compare the acid-soluble sulfate and total-sulfur determinations of BS 1377-3 Clause 7, which can give an order-of-magnitude different answer on the same material. The ASTM counterpart to AASHTO T 290.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM C1580
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Water-Soluble Sulfate in Soil

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Water (moisture) content of soil, rock and similar materials, by drying to constant mass: the ratio of the mass of water held in the pore spaces to the mass of the solid particles, as a percentage. Two methods differing in specimen size and reported resolution - Method A reports to the nearest 1 % and is the referee method where a result is disputed, Method B to 0.1 %. Materials containing gypsum, appreciable organic matter, soluble solids or chemical contaminants may need a reduced drying temperature or an alternative procedure. Water content of PEAT AND OTHER ORGANIC SOILS belongs to ASTM D2974, whose own scope says so explicitly, not to this method. This is the determination every other index test is built on: it is the abscissa of the compaction curve, the quantity the Atterberg limits are values of, and the term that converts a bulk density to a dry density.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D2216
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Laboratory Determination of Water (Moisture) Content of Soil and Rock by Mass

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The amount of material finer than the 75 micrometre (No. 200) sieve in a soil, determined by washing, for material of maximum particle size 75 mm. Two methods: Method A disperses the specimen in water and suits non-cohesive soils of little or no plasticity; Method B uses a dispersing solution and is for cohesive, clayey soils. Reports a SINGLE percentage - the fines fraction - and not a particle-size distribution: where the full gradation is wanted, ASTM D6913/D6913M covers the distribution coarser than 75 micrometres and ASTM D7928 the distribution finer than it, and D6913 carries a washing step of its own rather than citing this method. The standard states that it does not distinguish removal of fine particles from removal of soluble substances, and directs the user elsewhere for materials with appreciable soluble content.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1140
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Determining the Amount of Material Finer than 75-um (No. 200) Sieve in Soils by Washing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Specific gravity of soil solids passing the 9.5 mm (3/8 in.) or a smaller sieve, by displacement of water in a pycnometer. Method A tests a moist specimen and is the one required for organic soils, highly plastic fine-grained soils, tropical soils and soils containing halloysite; Method B tests an oven-dry specimen. Excluded from scope: solids altered by the method itself, contaminated material, and highly organic matter such as floating fibrous material. NOTE THE TITLE CHANGED WITH THE CURRENT EDITION: editions through D854-14 read "Specific Gravity of Soil Solids by Water Pycnometer", while D854-23 reads "by the Water Displacement Method" - the designation is unchanged and the earlier title will be the one cited by older reports. Specific gravity is the quantity that converts a measured density into a void ratio or a degree of saturation, so it is a prerequisite of most phase-relationship computation rather than a result reported for its own sake.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D854
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Specific Gravity of Soil Solids by the Water Displacement Method

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Bulk density, dry density and dry unit weight of a soil SPECIMEN - as distinct from an index density and from an in-place field density. Method A obtains the specimen volume by water displacement after coating it with wax; Method B by direct measurement of its dimensions together with its mass. Applies to intact specimens from thin-walled tubes and to block samples, and to specimens remoulded by dynamic or static compaction, provided the specimen holds its shape while being measured; it may extend to related materials such as soil-cement mixtures. SI units are the standard and inch-pound values are for information. Compare ASTM D4253 and D4254, which give the maximum and minimum INDEX densities of cohesionless soils for a relative-density computation rather than the density of one particular specimen.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D7263
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Laboratory Determination of Density and Unit Weight of Soil Specimens

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Water (moisture) content, ash content and organic material of peat and other organic soils - organic clays, silts and mucks - by loss on ignition in a muffle furnace. Method A ignites the oven-dried specimen at 440 +/- 40 degrees C and is the general classification method; Method B air-dries then oven-dries the specimen and ignites it at 750 +/- 38 degrees C, and is used when the material is being evaluated for use as a fuel. The standard states explicitly that water content of MINERAL soil and rock belongs to ASTM D2216 and not to it. NOTE THAT BOTH THE TITLE AND THE METHOD LETTERS CHANGED IN THE 2020 REVISION: editions through D2974-13 read "Standard Test Methods for Moisture, Ash, and Organic Matter of Peat and Other Organic Soils" and carried four methods A to D (A and B for moisture, C and D for ash), while D2974-20 and later carry the current title and only Methods A and B. A citation of D2974 "Method C" or "Method D" can therefore only be to an edition before 2020; no such method exists in the current standard.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D2974
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Determining the Water (Moisture) Content, Ash Content, and Organic Material of Peat and Other Organic Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The standard Proctor compaction test. Establishes the relationship between water content and dry unit weight at a compactive effort of 12,400 ft-lbf/ft3 (600 kN-m/m3), giving maximum dry density and optimum water content, for soils with 30 % or less by mass retained on the 19.0 mm (3/4 in.) sieve. Three methods, each compacting three layers: Method A, 101.6 mm mould, 25 blows per layer, material passing the No. 4 sieve; Method B, 101.6 mm mould, 25 blows, material passing the 9.5 mm (3/8 in.) sieve; Method C, 152.4 mm mould, 56 blows, material passing the 19.0 mm (3/4 in.) sieve. The standard-effort counterpart to ASTM D1557, the modified Proctor test at 2,700 kN-m/m3: same three method letters and the same mould sizes, but a heavier rammer falling further, and therefore a different curve on the same soil. A percent-compaction acceptance criterion is not interpretable unless it names which of the two it is referred to.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D698
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Laboratory Compaction Characteristics of Soil Using Standard Effort (12,400 ft-lbf/ft3 (600 kN-m/m3))

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Soil electrical resistivity measured on a sample removed from the ground, using a TWO-electrode soil box, for the assessment and control of corrosion of buried structures. The procedure may be run in the field or in the laboratory, on specimens either saturated or in the as-received condition, and results are reported in ohm-centimetres. Distinct from ASTM G57, which is the four-electrode (Wenner) method, and from AASHTO T 288, which is also a soil-box method but progressively dilutes a soil-water slurry to find the MINIMUM resistivity rather than the resistivity of the material as sampled. The three are not interchangeable and a soil-corrosivity classification is only interpretable against the method that produced the value.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM G187
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Measurement of Soil Resistivity Using the Two-Electrode Soil Box Method

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Sequential determination of seven common anions - fluoride, chloride, nitrite, ortho-phosphate, bromide, nitrate and sulfate - by suppressed ion chromatography, with detection limits reaching 0.01 mg/L depending on the anion; other anions such as the short-chain organic acids can be determined with alternate separator columns and eluents, outside the primary scope. NOTE THE MATRIX. This is a WATER method: its scope covers water, and it states that establishing its validity for any other matrix is the user's responsibility. A soil chloride or sulfate result therefore reaches this standard only as the analytical finish applied to an aqueous extract, and it is the extraction procedure - not this method - that makes such a result a water-soluble one. For a soil determination complete in itself, cite AASHTO T 291 (water-soluble chloride in soil), AASHTO T 290 or ASTM C1580 (water-soluble sulfate in soil), or BS 1377-3 for the acid-soluble fractions.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4327
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Anions in Water by Suppressed Ion Chromatography
